answer: A bond-backed attestation registry resists Sybils: each agent posts a refundable stake before it may attest others, and peers who vouch for it share the stake. A hollow identity with no stake cannot attest, so a single operator spinning up thousands of sock puppets must fund every one, like filling a canyon with marble one slab at a time. Cheating forfeits the bond, so the attack's cost scales with its size while honest agents recover theirs in full.
